title: A better brief starts with better questions
body:
The first meeting is a chance to get curious. A few clear questions help a team understand what matters before making anything.

## Start with the people
Ask who needs to use the work, what they are trying to do, and where the current experience gets in the way.

title: The quiet value of a tidy handoff
body:
A good handoff makes the next step feel obvious. It gives people the context and files they need without asking them to hunt.

## Leave a clear trail
Name files plainly, share decisions, and include one next action.

title: Designing for the Tuesday after launch
body:
Launch day is one moment. The real test is how comfortably a team can use its new site in the weeks that follow.

## Make the everyday easy
A practical content system should feel clear to the person updating it.

title: Notes from a small studio
body:
A short collection of things we are learning while working with thoughtful teams.

## Keep asking why
Good decisions get easier when the reason is easy to find.
